bull.probability_evidence: Bull case: FCF margin could recover from 10.5% TTM toward the 14.5% FY2025 level (research/HON/2026-10-09-evaluation.md Bull case; factsheet-2026-10-09.md Quality/CF,IS); management has set growth and margin targets through 2029 and describes 'strong orders and backlog' (Deutsche Bank Chicago Industrials Summit transcript, 2026-08-11, factsheet News & sentiment); the Dangote refinery wins support the UOP/process-technology franchise (Business Wire/Reuters, 2026-09-30, factsheet News & sentiment); buybacks keep cutting the share count -1.87% YoY (factsheet Other, ST). Probability kept at 20% (below an even third) because the macro overlay applies a moderate tilt toward the bear case (research/HON/2026-10-09-macro.md macro_tilt).
